tool.name: eScriptorium
tool.description: segment, transcribe and train models on images and PDFs
tool.command: #import shlex #def stage($datasets, $folder) #for $index, $dataset in enumerate($datasets) #if $dataset #set $name = str($dataset.element_identifier).replace('/', '_') #if '.' not in $name #set $name = $name + '.' + str($dataset.ext) #end if #set $target = 'inputs/%s/%04d.%s' % ($folder, $index, str($dataset.ext)) mkdir -p '$target' && ln -s '$dataset' ${shlex.quote($target + '/' + $name)} && #end if #end for #end def #for $doc_index, $doc in enumerate($documents) #if $doc.files #set $folder = 'documents/%04d' % $doc_index #set $title = 'Galaxy imports' if $doc_index == 0 else 'Galaxy imports %d' % ($doc_index + 1) mkdir -p 'inputs/$folder' && printf %s ${shlex.quote($title)} > 'inputs/$folder/name' && $stage([$d for $d in $doc.files if $d and str($d.ext) in ('png', 'jpg', 'tiff', 'pdf')], $folder + '/pages') $stage([$d for $d in $doc.files if $d and str($d.ext) in ('xml', 'zip')], $folder + '/annotations') $stage([$d for $d in $doc.files if $d and str($d.ext) in ('mlmodel', 'safetensors')], 'models/%04d' % $doc_index) #end if #end for exec bash '$__tool_directory__/start.sh'

param.name: files
param.label: Inputs
param.help: Select files or a collection for one document. Add a document to keep another group separate. Model type is detected automatically.

tool.help:
Opens eScriptorium with one project. Each input group becomes one document: Galaxy imports, Galaxy imports 2, and so on. Select files together or supply a collection to import its elements in order into one document. Add a group for each separate document. Select at least one file. Images and PDFs become pages; PAGE/ALTO XML and ZIP annotations are imported into the same document after its pages. Models are imported into the session.
Exports created in eScriptorium and all models of the session are added to the history as separate datasets when the tool is stopped. Wait for an export to finish before stopping the tool.
